text: {"claims":[{"quote":"we expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter-on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens and we have a strong order book","metric":"20%‑25% QoQ volume growth","promised":"20% to 25% quarter‑on‑quarter volume growth","horizon":"next quarter"},{"quote":"We expect the JV to commence operations and start reflecting in our revenues from Q3 of the current fiscal","metric":"JV revenue contribution from Q3 FY2026","promised":"JV will start contributing to revenue","horizon":"Q3 of the current fiscal"},{"quote":"We expect the operations to commence from Q3 of this fiscal","metric":"Facility operations start Q3 FY2026","promised":"Operations will begin","horizon":"Q3 of this fiscal"},{"quote":"we are expanding the capacities of camera module ... to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months","metric":"Camera module capacity 180‑190 million units per year","promised":"Capacity will reach 180‑190 million annually","horizon":"next 15‑18 months"},{"quote":"we expect to also commence exports of these products during the current fiscal year","metric":"Start of exports in FY2026","promised":"Exports will begin","horizon":"current fiscal year"},{"quote":"We expect to start export deliveries to the largest retail chain in U.S. and Germany in Q2 and Q3 of this fiscal","metric":"Export deliveries to US and Germany in Q2‑Q3 FY2026","promised":"Export deliveries will start in Q2 and Q3","horizon":"Q2 and Q3 of this fiscal"},{"quote":"by the first half, we would be close to around 16 million, 16.5 million","metric":"First‑half phone shipments 16‑16.5 million units","promised":"Ship 16‑16.5 million phones in H1","horizon":"first half of FY2026"},{"quote":"we still feel that we'll be holding on to our numbers of last year","metric":"Full‑year phone shipments 32‑33 million units","promised":"Maintain last year’s volume of 32‑33 million phones","horizon":"full fiscal year 2026"}]}
